body.intent: Remove the error sources that held ship-change runs: retry GitHub 5xx and GraphQL errors with backoff, stop once with GitHub's reason instead of looping on a refused merge, reconcile an origin branch that holds the run's own earlier pushes, and turn land's PR-head conflicts, duplicate actor handles and Rex tab failures into a retry or one clear stop. Evidence: 59 holds, 97.6h ALL; open-pr 13, gate-rebase-merge max_visits 9, land 6, code-check 4, Rex tab 4 (perf report section d, rec 3).
